import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int p = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        final long mod = 1000000007L;

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(pow(p, p - 1, mod));
        } else if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(pow(p, p, mod));
        } else {
            List<Integer> divisorsList = divisors(p - 1);
            for (int z : divisorsList) {
                if (( (p - 1) % z == 0) && (pow(k, z, p) == 1)) {
                    System.out.println(pow(p, (p - 1) / z, mod));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static List<Integer> divisors(int n) {
        Set<Integer> ans = new HashSet<>();
        int i = 1;
        while (i * i <= n) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                ans.add(i);
                ans.add(n / i);
            }
            i++;
        }
        List<Integer> sortedAns = new ArrayList<>(ans);
        Collections.sort(sortedAns);
        return sortedAns;
    }

    static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long pow(int base, int exp, int p) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base % p;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * b) % p;
            }
            b = (b * b) % p;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
